title: Change in Velocity
text: The ball goes from +30 m/s to -40 m/s. Change in velocity: Δv = v_f - v_i = -40 - 30 = -70 m/s. The negative shows direction reversal.

title: Change in Momentum
text: Δp = mΔv = 0.15 × (-70) = -10.5 kg·m/s. This is also the impulse delivered by the bat.

title: Finding the Force
text: F = Δp/Δt = -10.5/0.02 = -525 N. The magnitude is 525 N - this is a large force acting for a very short time!
